effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Myotismon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. If you added cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
